versions.summary: A 240-acre council Scouts BSA resident summer camp located in Bucks County, Pennsylvania.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The camp's own program guide, linked from that page, was read as the second source.
